BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   B. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   D. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
